alternatives_named: Don't broaden gate dirs — instead emit evidence in the original 3 dirs even if it lives elsewhere
Glob-based evidence dirs (evidence/*) instead of enumerated list

rejected_reasons: Emitting duplicate evidence in 3-dir scope creates write-once history pollution.
Glob-based scanning is non-deterministic and could pick up transient/temp files.
Dropping the entries violates user directive 'implement every scoped plan item' and would leave a permanent index/source drift.
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Enumerated 10-dir broadening matches actual evidence layout, stays deterministic, and resolves the false-negative class without producing duplicate evidence.
